periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward orientation at approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop morphology, characterized as distinctly oval with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering where the geometric center is shifted significantly upward relative to the narrowest lowest point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped posterior edge with smooth curvature across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the transverse axis, occupying approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral set, with the inter-pinna gap roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular with a smooth, continuous convex curvature at the top boundary.
